raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The `custom`, `hf`, `spec_bench` and `speed_bench` datasets apply the tokenizer's chat template to each prompt unless `--skip-chat-template` is passed. With `--backend openai-chat`, `openai-responses` or `vllm-chat`, that already-templated prompt is sent as the content of a user message, and the server (or `LLM.chat` for `vllm bench throughput`) applies the template a second time. The model sees two nested templates, and input token counts are inflated.

`get_samples` now treats chat backends as `--skip-chat-template`. Completion backends (`openai`, `vllm`) keep the client-side template, since their endpoint takes raw text.

On Qwen2.5-1.5B with 8 custom-dataset prompts and `--backend openai-chat`, using server-reported usage:

| client | total input tokens | per request |
|---|---|---|
| main | 384 | 48 |
| this PR | 232 | 29 |

232 matches the same prompts sent through `--backend openai` with the client template, so the chat path now sends one template.

## Tests

- `pytest tests/benchmarks/test_custom_dataset_chat_template_kwargs.py`: 7 passed. On main, the three new chat-backend cases fail and the two completion-backend cases pass.
- `pytest tests/benchmarks` (excluding the serve/throughput/latency CLI tests): the same 9 tests fail on main and on this branch (`test_bench_startup`, `test_forward_cli`, `test_mm_processor_cli`), all `FileNotFoundError: 'vllm'` from the `vllm` CLI not being on PATH in my environment.
- GPU check above on an RTX 3080.

## Duplicate check

Searched open PRs and issues for skip-chat-template / chat template applied twice in the bench client; found none.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to write the change and tests. I reviewed every line and ran the commands above.

@@ -73,3 +73,38 @@ def test_chat_template_kwargs_default_is_noop(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
     get_samples(_args(str(jsonl), None), tok)
 
     assert tok.captured_kwargs == {}
+
+
+def _backend_args(dataset_path: str, backend: str | None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    args = _args(dataset_path, None)
+    if backend is not None:
+        args.backend = backend
+    return args
+
+
+@pytest.mark.benchmark
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["openai-chat", "openai-responses", "vllm-chat"])
+def test_chat_backends_skip_client_side_template(tmp_path: Path, backend: str) -> None:
+    """Chat backends apply the template themselves; rendering it client-side
+    too would send the model a doubly templated prompt."""
+    jsonl = tmp_path / "data.jsonl"
+    _write_one(jsonl)
+
+    tok = _RecordingTokenizer()
+    get_samples(_backend_args(str(jsonl), backend), tok)
+
+    assert tok.captured_kwargs is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.benchmark
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["openai", "vllm"])
+def test_completion_backends_keep_client_side_template(
+    tmp_path: Path, backend: str
+) -> None:
+    jsonl = tmp_path / "data.jsonl"
+    _write_one(jsonl)
+
+    tok = _RecordingTokenizer()
+    get_samples(_backend_args(str(jsonl), backend), tok)
+
+    assert tok.captured_kwargs == {}
